messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — Gateway partner (EdgeGrid) sent over creative for marketplace listing. Need a quick asset sanity check before we hand to marketing. Main asks: 1) co-branded logo lockup 2) one-pager hero image 3) short customer quote verification. Can we review today?
Jen (Design): I can do a pass. Do we have high-res SVGs and a transparent hero PNG at 1200x628? Also need Figma link.
Maria Lopez: I have the files but EdgeGrid supplied a 900px JPG and an EPS. Not ideal. Uploading to the drive now: https://drive.example.com/edgegrid-assets (private).@Jen (Design) please confirm exact spec.
Jen (Design): Quick checklist: logos: SVG + 2 PNGs (light/dark) at 512px. Hero: 1200x628 PNG, sRGB, <1MB if possible. One-pager PDF: bleed ok but keep copy editable. File naming convention: `edgegrid_logo_primary.svg`, `edgegrid_logo_primary_dark.png`, `edgegrid_hero_marketplace_1200x628.png`, `edgegrid_onepager_v1.pdf`
Alex Kim: Perfect. Also need the legal-approved quote text. They gave: "Redwood + EdgeGrid reduced inference latency by 2.1x in our beta." Can legal confirm we can publish that verbatim?
Sam Legal: @Alex Kim @Maria Lopez quick read: the quote is OK but we need a sign-off from EdgeGrid's legal with email trail. Also request permission for logo usage in marketing + marketplace tile. Can we get a signed license or a short email from their GC?
Maria Lopez: I asked their PM and copied their GC earlier today, waiting on confirmation. I’ll ping them again.
Josh Patel: FYI — product wants the hero to include a small performance stat callout (e.g., "2.1x lower inference latency"). Is that cleared? If not, we should do a neutral phrasing like "significant latency improvements".
Sam Legal: Callout with a numeric claim requires citation (internal benchmark doc or customer-approved metric). If they confirm the 2.1x with a short attestation, we can include it. Otherwise use qualitative phrasing.
pm-bot: Checklist created: [logos, hero, one-pager, legal sign-off, Figma link, file naming]. Reminder: marketplace tile spec — 1:1 at 1200x1200, PNG.
Jen (Design): Noted — will prepare an export pack and small thumbnail for the marketplace tile. Can someone confirm color lock (EdgeGrid primary blue) won't conflict with our tile background? Prefer to use white lockup on brand-blue or dark gradient.
Alex Kim: Use white lockup on dark gradient. Maria, once legal sign-off is in, can we aim to ship assets to marketing by EOD tomorrow?
Maria Lopez: Yes — if EdgeGrid GC signs off by noon I can hand off to marketing. I’ll follow up now. :+1:
Jen (Design): Working on the pack — will upload to the drive under `/for-marketing/edgegrid/` when ready.
Alex Kim: Thanks team — keep this thread for updates. If legal comes back, paste the email here so we have the trail.
Maria Lopez: Copy — ping sent to GC. Will post update here when they reply.
